chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from one of our companions, who said:

One of the two Imams (peace be upon them) said: 'The man should pray the two cycles of the Tawaf, the obligatory Tawaf and the optional one, with [Surah] Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad and [Surah] Qul Ya Ayyuha al-Kafirun.'

key_terms.بِقُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: With 'Say: He is Allah, One' (Surah Al-Ikhlas)
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الطَّوَافِ: The two cycles of prayer performed after circumambulation
key_terms.طَوَافِ الْفَرِيضَةِ: The obligatory circumambulation (of Hajj or Umrah)

ai.seo_question: What Surahs should be recited in the two cycles of prayer after Tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that the two-cycle prayer following the circumambulation of the Kaaba is a consistent practice for both the obligatory (Fard) and voluntary (Nafl) Tawaf, emphasizing the spiritual continuity of the ritual. By prescribing the recitation of Surah Al-Ikhlas and Al-Kafirah, it highlights the themes of divine unity and distinctness from polytheism, which are central to the pilgrim's devotion. This ruling underscores the importance of adhering to specific Sunnah recitations in the sacred precincts, reinforcing the theological depth of the Hajj and Umrah rituals within Shia jurisprudence.
